content: Go libp2p gossipsub PeerScoreThresholds (score_params.go, master): GossipThreshold (score below which gossip propagation suppressed, must be <=0), PublishThreshold (below which no publishing/fanout, <= GossipThreshold), GraylistThreshold (below which ALL message processing suppressed = effective graylist, <= PublishThreshold), AcceptPXThreshold (positive), OpportunisticGraftThreshold (small positive). validate() enforces the negative ordering. BehaviourPenalty: P7 score applies squared excess above BehaviourPenaltyThreshold with BehaviourPenaltyWeight, decays by BehaviourPenaltyDecay per heartbeat interval. Mesh/message-delivery deficits (MeshMessageDeliveriesThreshold) penalize peers failing delivery while in mesh.
